safety.title: Community Safety & Emergency Preparedness
safety.sub: Crucial step-by-step guidance during critical emergencies. Stay calm, ensure personal safety first, and notify response personnel.
safety.fire_p1: Evacuate immediately: Do not use elevators; use marked fire escape stairs.
safety.fire_p2: Stay low under smoke: Toxic gases rise; crawl where air is cleanest.
safety.fire_p3: Test doors before opening: Feel doorknobs with the back of your hand. If hot, do not open.
safety.fire_p4: Report exact floor & room: Submit a report on SURAKSHA with landmark and people trapped.
safety.accident_p1: Secure the scene: Turn on vehicle hazard lights; place warning triangles if safe.
safety.accident_p2: Good Samaritan Protection: Indian law protects bystanders assisting accident victims from police harassment.
safety.accident_p3: Do not move injured spinal victims: Unless there is imminent fire or explosion risk.
safety.accident_p4: Pin location on SURAKSHA: Enable GPS to guide emergency ambulance navigation.
safety.medical_p1: Assess responsiveness: Gently shake shoulders and ask loudly, 'Are you okay?'
safety.medical_p2: Check breathing & pulse: If unresponsive with no normal breathing, begin chest compressions (100–120 bpm).
safety.medical_p3: Heat exhaustion: Move to cool shade, loosen clothing, elevate feet, offer cool water if conscious.
safety.medical_p4: Clear the path: Have someone wait on the main road to flag down incoming paramedics.
safety.suspicious_p1: Never confront suspects alone: Maintain safe distance and observe from well-lit areas.
safety.suspicious_p2: Unattended items: Do NOT touch, kick, or open unattended bags or suspicious containers.
safety.suspicious_p3: Note key identifiers: Note clothing color, height, vehicle number plates, and direction of travel.
safety.suspicious_p4: Use SOS: If feeling directly threatened or followed, activate SURAKSHA SOS for immediate beacon broadcast.
safety.missing_p1: Zero waiting period: There is NO 24-hour waiting rule for missing children or vulnerable adults in India.
safety.missing_p2: Recent photo: Have the most recent, clear photograph ready to attach on SURAKSHA.
safety.missing_p3: Specific clothing markers: Color of shirt, shoes, birthmarks, and languages spoken.
safety.missing_p4: Last known location: Report the exact spot, gate number, or transit station where last seen.
safety.kit_p1: Power bank & cables: Keep a charged 10,000mAh+ power bank ready at all times.
safety.kit_p2: First Aid pouch: Bandages, antiseptic liquid, sterile gauze, burn ointment, ORS packets.
safety.kit_p3: Emergency Contacts: Memorize 2 family contact numbers in case phone battery depletes.
safety.kit_p4: Whistle & torch: Simple, non-electronic signaling tools during night hazards or power outages.
